messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — our reference JS SDK change to the package `exports` map is breaking the Next.js edge sample app when running on the edge runtime. Getting `Error: Cannot find module` from the edge bundler.
Maria P: Ugh, which variant did we publish? The conditional exports for cjs/imports maybe?
Alex K: We moved to conditional exports to prefer ESM, e.g. in package.json: "\"exports\": {\"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\",\"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs\"}". Locally works, but the edge bundler tries to resolve `./dist/index.js` and fails.
Sam R: Edge runtimes (V8 isolates) often expect an entrypoint without node-specific resolution. Could be the bundler (esbuild/next) not honoring `require` conditional.
Leo T: Also seeing TypeScript users complaining — their `types` entry points are pointing at `dist/index.d.ts` but our export map prevents TS from seeing it unless we add an explicit `types` export.
Maria P: Screenshot from the sample app CI log: `Error: Package subpath './dist/index.cjs' is not defined by "exports"` — that means the bundler attempted a pinned path.
Alex K: deploy-bot: patch release 0.24.1 created for sdk-js.
deploy-bot: Release 0.24.1 published — includes export map fallback and an extra `types` export.
Sam R: Proposed immediate fix: add a top-level `.` export that covers both esm and cjs and explicitly export `./index.d.ts` under `types`. Eg: "\"exports\": {\".\": {\"import\":\"./dist/index.mjs\",\"require\":\"./dist/index.cjs\"}, \"./package.json\":\"./package.json\",\"./index.d.ts\":\"./dist/index.d.ts\"}"
Leo T: I can add a small change to the sample app bundler config to prefer the `import` entry and inline the file for edge. But we should make the SDK tolerate bundlers that do path-based lookups.
Maria P: Also note: some consumers do `require('sdk-js/dist')` which will fail if `dist/` is not listed in exports. We intentionally removed implicit folder fallbacks for hygiene, but that broke downstream users.
Alex K: We removed the implicit dist surface to discourage deep imports. But given real-world usage, we should add explicit internal subpaths for `dist/*` that we support for the next minor.
Sam R: For typings, TypeScript 4.7+ supports `exports` aware resolution but older versions don't. We need to document that older TS may need `paths` override or update tsconfig.
Leo T: Compat plan: 1) publish 0.24.1 with broad `.` export and explicit `./package.json` and `./dist/*` aliases, 2) update sample apps + CI to bundle ESM entry for edge, 3) add migration note in changelog and examples.
Maria P: Can we add a small runtime check in SDK that throws a helpful error if require/import resolution fails with suggestions? e.g., "Use the ESM entry for edge runtimes or upgrade your bundler". That would help support.
Alex K: Good idea. Add a friendly message and link to docs. Also add an automated test: run Next.js edge sample in CI smoke suite against published tarball to catch regressions.
Sam R: I'll open two PRs: one to revert the strict limiting of exports and one to add the runtime hint + changelog.
Leo T: Assigning myself to update the sample app docs and add a code snippet for edge: ```js
// next.config.js
module.exports = {
  experimental: { runtime: 'edge' },
  webpack: (cfg) => {
    cfg.resolve.mainFields = ['module', 'browser', 'main']
    return cfg
  }
}
```
Maria P: Thanks — also add a TS note: if users see `Could not find a declaration file for module`, ensure `moduleResolution` is `bundler` or add `skipLibCheck=false` and set `types` mapping.
Alex K: OK shipping plan: cut 0.24.1 today with the export fixes, update sample-app pinned SHA, run smoke CI. If all green, announce rollback instructions for any customers who pinned 0.24.0.
Sam R: I'll post a short blurb for the Support channel with exact error text and recommended temp workaround (`npm install sdk-js@0.24.1` or change import to `import sdk from 'sdk-js/dist/index.mjs'`).
Leo T: Leaving a note to check any third-party packages that import from `sdk-js/dist` — they should be fine after 0.24.1 but we should avoid breaking changes in minors.
Maria P: Thanks team — please add the changelog entry and ping me when PRs are green.
Alex K: Closing loop: deploy-bot: created release PR linking SDK, sample-app updates, and changelog.
deploy-bot: CI status: sample-app smoke (edge) — running...
